proposals.evidence: CDIAL 7655 pañca explicitly gives Gawri ponc, Khowar ponj, Bshk. panž, Punjabi panj and eastern pā̃c/pā̃s “five”. Survey affricate/sibilant variants identify this numeral family, while an unexplained final glide is held separately. The exact regional route may include borrowing between Indo-Aryan languages; the supported family is linked under the user’s preference.

The exact regional route may include borrowing between Indo-Aryan languages; the supported family is linked under the user’s preference.
